Hold [Reload] to consume your grenade charge over a 2.3 second animation that <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine and prepares an explosive <bold [projectile | shape | language] />. Can consume both Transcendence Grenades and Song of Flame Wisps.

The explosive's damage type always matches your equipped grenade, and deals <pve 3,311 /> <pvp [223] /> damage in a 6 meter radius on impact. Kills trigger a second explosion for <pve 67.2? /> <pvp [44.8?] /> damage in a 2.4? meter radius.

The <bold [projectile | shape | language] />'s damage is increased by 19% if you are Transcendent.
